narrative.northStar: The receipt is the unit of truth
narrative.overview: Thermal-paper whites and ink-dark numerals on a faintly green-grey ground, one forint-green accent, amber reserved for review. Precision over decoration; the receipt slip with a perforated tear edge is the signature object.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Only forint green carries emphasis; categories are identified by icon + name.

rules.name: Tabular Columns
rules.body: Aligned amounts use tabular figures; the hero figure stays proportional.

dos: Show uncertainty with amber markers and reconciliation lines
Keep every amount exact and traceable to a receipt line
donts: Don't use eyebrow labels or gradient text
Don't fill missing receipt data silently
